knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The household buys the outcome, a home that feels ready, with a checklist and a return visit. The hourly rate and equipment list are inputs, not the outcome.
A return visit is a guarantee the business controls and can staff, so the business can afford to deliver it. Guarantees must be deliverable and affordable.
A marketplace per-hour figure is a vendor reference only. The lesson says to note that, then price from your own measured hours and cost.
